zh.closed: 完整闭眼，轻轻收紧眼睑，保持 3 秒；不要按压眼球。
zh.follow: 保持头部自然稳定，跟随蝴蝶；可以自然眨眼。
zh.move: 保持头部自然稳定，用眼睛跟随目标。
zh.proto: 交互原型：按钮只展示页面和流程；没有接入眼动、通知或 PICO SDK。
zh.notice: 佩戴累计 60 分钟后提醒，支持 30～120 分钟设置。
zh.stop: 如果感到疼痛或眩晕，请停止并摘下头显休息。

en.tagline: Give your eyes a little break
en.closed: Close your eyes fully and gently squeeze your eyelids for 3 seconds. Do not press on your eyes.
en.follow: Keep your head comfortably steady. Follow the butterfly and blink naturally.
en.move: Keep your head comfortably steady. Follow the target with your eyes.
en.proto: Interaction prototype only: no eye tracking, notification or PICO SDK integration.
en.notice: Reminder after 60 minutes of headset wear. Adjustable from 30 to 120 minutes.
en.stop: If you feel pain or dizziness, stop and remove the headset to rest.
